description: Apply fills and strokes to items, to the text in text frames, or to placed grayscale and bitmap images (colourise): a colour, a gradient or None (Apply Color, Apply Gradient, Apply None), tint, overprint, and the gradient's angle, length and start as set with the Gradient panel or Gradient Swatch tool, or reverse it; or swap fill and stroke, or reset them to the defaults (Tools panel)

applyTo.description: item: the frame or shape (Formatting affects container); text: the text of text frames, or selected text (Formatting affects text); content: the placed graphic inside the frame, colourising a grayscale or bitmap image. Default item

defaults.description: Default Fill and Stroke: fill None and stroke Black (text: fill Black and stroke None), before fill and stroke options

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch); a gradient swatch name applies the gradient; "None" removes the fill (Apply Color, Apply Gradient, Apply None)

gradientAngle.description: Angle of the applied gradient (degrees, Gradient panel > Angle)

gradientLength.description: Length of a linear gradient, or radius of a radial one (mm), as dragged with the Gradient Swatch tool

gradientStart.description: Start point (linear) or centre (radial) of the gradient as [x, y] in mm from the top-left of the item's page, as dragged with the Gradient Swatch tool

reverseGradient.description: Reverse the applied gradient (Gradient panel > Reverse), by turning its angle 180°

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch); a gradient swatch name applies the gradient; "None" removes the stroke (Apply Color, Apply Gradient, Apply None)

gradientStart.description: Start point (linear) or centre (radial) of the gradient as [x, y] in mm from the top-left of the item's page, as dragged with the Gradient Swatch tool

reverseGradient.description: Reverse the applied gradient (Gradient panel > Reverse), by turning its angle 180°

swap.description: Swap Fill and Stroke: exchange the fill and stroke colours and tints (before fill and stroke options)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_fill_stroke
